results.name: nuxt
results.note: Nuxt 4.4.8 (last Rollup-based line; >=4.5.0 needs vite 8 / rolldown whose @rolldown/binding-wasm32-wasi spawns a real worker_threads WASI thread pool at require time - impossible in a single-threaded browser worker). Installs cleanly with Vite 7, runs loadNuxt + build(nuxt) in-VM, connects Vite-node over Unix socket IPC to Nitro in its virtual worker_threads Worker, and SSR-renders app/app.vue over loopback HTTP. Nuxt >=4.5.0 recorded as blocked, not claimed

results.name: sveltekit
results.note: SvelteKit 2.70.4 sync + vite 7 build with the kit plugin and adapter-node (precompress enabled: both .gz and .br precompressed assets are produced via createGzip and embedded WASM createBrotliCompress). SvelteKit 3 peers vite 8 / rolldown, whose @rolldown/binding-wasm32-wasi spawns a real worker_threads WASI thread pool at require time - a single-threaded browser worker cannot nest real threads, so that line is recorded as blocked here rather than claimed
